extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires about £45,500 of funding for a client's representation in ongoing matrimonial proceedings where the disputed assets are around £515,500 and a hearing is listed for 10 November.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To progress our review we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the proceedings, details of the stage reached and the nature and location of the assets in dispute, and an indication of your client's costs budget. We would also need your firm's details and client identification information in the usual way. A member of the team will be in touch once we have had a chance to consider the information provided. Please note that no funding decision or terms are implied by this acknowledgement.
